title: Nvidia joins WEKA's $140M Series E

sources.quote: Generation Investment Management, NVIDIA, Atreides Management, 10D, Hitachi Ventures, Ibex Investors, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, MoreTech Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures joined Valor in contributing to the round.

explain: Nvidia invested again in WEKA, which makes software that feeds data to GPUs fast enough for AI training. The $140 million round, led by Valor Equity Partners, valued WEKA at $1.6 billion; Nvidia's share was not disclosed.
